topics.topic: Ownership and uniqueness scope of random identifier generation, collision checking, and retry
questions: Which module owns random identifier generation and the collision-check-and-remint rule, and how do `functions`, `bindings`, `runs` and `effects` obtain those identifiers without each owning the mechanism?
Which module owns random identifier generation and the atomic collision check, and is uniqueness checked within each record type or across all minted identifiers?
Which module owns random identifier generation and collision retry for records written by `functions`, `bindings`, `runs` and `effects`?

quotes:
`trial_execution_id` M07, `binding_id` M11, `run_id` M19, `approval_id` M24 and
   `grant_id` M25 are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is
   minted again.
judgement.why: The random-identifier rule and the absence of an assigned module owner were unchanged, and the change did not make that ownership matter differently.

topics.topic: Authoritative captured trial-case fit, size, and contract-version validation before fixture copying
questions: How can `runs` obtain the authoritative fit-and-size decision before copying files without duplicating a rule owned by `functions`, and which module owns the final contract-version match check?
Which module performs the authoritative captured-case fit and size preflight before `runs` copies fixture bytes, without duplicating `functions`' case-validation rules?

judgement.divergence: One implementer adds an authoritative non-mutating preflight in `functions`, so an invalid captured case is refused before any fixture bytes are copied; another duplicates validation in `runs` or calls `functions.add_captured_trial_case` only after copying, allowing differing refusal results or unreferenced fixture bytes when the final contract-version, fit, or size check fails, which the owner notices through capture results and persistent storage consumption.
judgement.why: The texts require all capture checks to pass before copying while assigning case validation to `functions`, but provide no authoritative validation-only path that `runs` can call before it has fixture digests.

topics.topic: How runs obtains accepted binding port declarations for runtime validation and delivery
questions: How does `runs` obtain the accepted binding's port declarations needed for runtime delivery and target-port validation?

topics.topic: Ownership and propagation of fatal-stop decisions after partial run movement
questions: Which module owns the fatal-stop decision and propagation when a run-moving request has committed an earlier change and a later store call fails?

topics.topic: Ownership of SpooledFile record creation versus fact supply by runs and effects
questions: Is SpooledFile a third record type with multiple semantic writers, or does `store.spool_file` solely own creation of its record while `runs` and `effects` only supply facts?

topics.topic: Ownership of aggregate StoredValue creation for a mapped node's collected output
questions: Which module creates the aggregate StoredValue representing a mapped operation node's collected `many` value output after all element executions conclude?

topics.topic: Ownership of stateful equal-content resubmission and deduplication behavior
questions: Does `canonical_values` own only identity/equality computation, or does it own the stateful deduplication behavior of A01 rule 4; if only computation, which domain or store module owns each record type's equal-submission behavior?

topics.topic: Ownership split for shared Port declaration validation and contextual checks
questions: Which lower module owns the common Port-declaration checks used by both contract issuance and binding proposal, and which contextual checks remain with `functions` and `bindings`?

topics.topic: Recovery handling of completed spool files left without a concluding NodeExecution record
questions: Who detects and removes or reuses completed spool files that are not named by a NodeExecution after a crash or store failure, and how does recovery avoid counting or colliding with them when it repeats the same next attempt number?

topics.topic: Shared ownership of instance-address and required-header validation
questions: Which module owns the common definition of valid instance addresses and required headers so proposal-time and send-time checks cannot diverge?

topics.topic: Storage location for bounded TrialExecution failure detail
questions: Where is the bounded failure detail of a failed trial execution recorded?

topics.topic: Whether missing flow references reject composition or produce a retained version with proof failure
questions: Does a missing contract version or binding named by a node make composition fail before keeping the version, or is the version kept with an A05 phase-1 proof failure?
